literature_notes: All six ledger lines (L1–L6) concern C-terminal tags (c-Myc, Rho-1D4, GFP/pEGFPN1) appended to full-length ANO4. The computed topology places the C-terminus (residues 899–955) firmly in the INTRACELLULAR compartment, so every one of these tags faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface. The N-terminus (residues 1–352) is likewise intracellular. No ledger line reports any insertion into an extracellular loop or domain of ANO4 or a close ortholog. L6 further confirms that GFP-tagged ANO4 shows mainly cytoplasmic fluorescence, consistent with intracellular localisation of the tag (and possible trafficking issues). Because no ledger line grounds a tag on the extracellular face, zero sites qualify.
